name: How does an AI Overview audit differ from a traditional SEO audit?
description: An AI Overview audit specifically optimizes content for AI summarization, while a traditional SEO audit focuses on general search engine ranking factors.

mainEntity.name: How does an AI Overview audit differ from a traditional SEO audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both aim to improve search visibility, an AI Overview audit focuses specifically on how AI models interpret and summarize your content. A traditional SEO audit primarily optimizes for search engine algorithms that rank pages. An AI audit scrutinizes content for clarity, conciseness, structured data implementation, and factual accuracy, ensuring it can be easily understood and presented by AI. It often involves content restructuring and semantic optimization, whereas a traditional SEO audit might focus more on keywords, backlinks, and technical crawlability.
